2896-4089-4808-5131.description:
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Glasspool Mimic by paying {2}{U}, causing it to enter with additional Shapeshifter Rogue types as a copy of Muldrotha.
Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Necromancy by paying {2}{B}.
When Necromancy enters, it triggers, becoming an Aura and returning Muldrotha from the graveyard to the battlefield with Necromancy attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.

4279-5075-7192--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-5075-7192--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Grave Venerations, Ogre Slumlord and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Grave Venerations triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2085-2645-3430-3664.easyPrerequisites: Kelpie Guide doesn't have summoning sickness.
2085-2645-3430-3664.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding nine mana of any color due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, untapping Lotus Field
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Kelpie Guide.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2734-5107-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Rally of Wings is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
2734-5107-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
2734-5107-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Cyberdrive Awakener.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Rally of Wings without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Rally of Wings, untapping all creatures you control and giving creatures you control that have flying +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

1322-2023-4289-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2043-4359-7826.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Bag End Banquet that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the Bag End Banquet token enters, it triggers, creating three Food tokens.
Activate the Bag End Banquet token by tapping it, adding {C} for each Food you control.
Repeat
2043-4359-7826.notes: You can reduce the cost by up to {3} if you control additional Food(s) as you start the combo. You can also tap the original Bag End Banquet for mana after the Foods are created initially if you're able to do so.

1308-2976-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
1308-2976-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Animate Land
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

978-2469-6972.description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought by paying its mana cost.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Repeat from step 2

891-2438-2730.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Repeat.

774-3257-5478.description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting  Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it triggers.
Activate Rakdos Carnarium by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Rakdos Carnarium's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1170-1329-1492-4742.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1170-1329-1492-4742.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Welding Jar from your graveyard.
Cast Welding Jar by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

630-2079-2366-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
630-2079-2366-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Keeper of Progenitus triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

198-512-4241.description:
Activate Karn twice by paying {2}, causing Halo Fountain and Empowered Autogenerator to become a creature.
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {W} for each charge counter on it.
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and then untapping it and Empowered Autogenerator, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
198-512-4241.notes: With the excess mana, you can use it on Halo Fountain's first ability, tapping and untapping it to create creature tokens. If Empowered Autogenerator has a charge counter on it, the {W} in the mana cost can be removed.

1550-2105-7060.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Hearth and Home attached to any creature you control except Combat Celebrant.
An opponent is unable to block Combat Celebrant or the creature with Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
You have not exerted Combat Celebrant this turn.
1550-2105-7060.description:
Declare the creature with Sword of Hearth and Home and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
Sword of Hearth and Home triggers, exiling Combat Celebrant, then causing you to search your library for a basic land card, then put the land and Combat Celebrant onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1879-6188-6911.notablePrerequisites:
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent. There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1879-6188-6911.description:
Declare Fear of Missing Out as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to untap it and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Fear of Missing Out, triggering Impostor Syndrome, creating a token copy of Fear of Missing Out that isn't legendary.
When the Fear of Missing Out token enters, it triggers, causing you to rummage
During your next combat phase, declare Fear of Missing Out and the Fear of Missing Out token as attackers.
The Fear of Missing Out token triggers, causing you to untap the nontoken Fear of Missing Out and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

1495-4522-4613-6843.notablePrerequisites: Quest for Pure Flame has at least four quest counters on it.
1495-4522-4613-6843.description:
Activate Quest for Pure Flame by removing four quest counters from it and sacrificing it, doubling the damage sources you control will deal this turn.
Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Quest for Pure Flame.
Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.

191-3017-6625.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
191-3017-6625.description:
Activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding a card.
Curator of Mysteries triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Ghostly Pilferer ability.
Repeat.

628-1077-1228-5571.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to give Goblin Sharpshooter deathtouch.
You control an additional nontoken non-Human creature that does not have indestructible or protection from red.
628-1077-1228-5571.description:
Give control of Blightbeetle to an opponent, if needed. Also, give Goblin Sharpshooter deathtouch, if needed.
Activate Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to the additional creature and destroying it due to Goblin Sharpshooter's deathtouch.
When the creature dies, its undying ability and Goblin Sharpshooter trigger.
Resolve the creature's undying trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Goblin Sharpshooter trigger, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2105-6591--85.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2034-2105-6591--85.description:
Declare Squall and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Combat Celebrant.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Squall, triggering Squall's second ability, returning Combat Celebrant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

147-4050-6475.description:
Cast Reunion of the House by paying {5}{W}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Reunion of the House.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Reunion of the House, targeting Dualcaster Mage and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Reunion of the House, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

396-864-1333-4050.notablePrerequisites: At least two of your opponents have a creature card in their graveyard.
396-864-1333-4050.description:
Cast Ghouls' Night Out by paying {3}{B}{B}, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield, and at least two other creatures from your opponents' graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Eternal Witness and the creatures enter the battlefield, Blessed Sanctuary triggers once for each creature, and Eternal Witness triggers once.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Ghouls' Night Out from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve all Blessed Sanctuary triggers, creating that many 2/2 Unicorn creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing Eternal Witness, two creatures your opponents own, and two Unicorns, adding {3}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2222-3858-5200.notablePrerequisites: Sword of the Paruns attached to Auriok Bladewarden.
2222-3858-5200.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers.
Holding priority, activate Auriok Bladewarden by tapping it, giving itself +X/+X until end of turn, where X is its power, which is increased by 2 due to Sword of the Paruns.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Auriok Bladewarden.
Repeat from step 2 until Auriok Bladewarden has power nineteen or greater, omitting step 3 on the final iteration.
Resolve the Mayael's Aria trigger from step 1, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain 10 life and win the game.

2034-2946-2948.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2034-2946-2948.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cult Conscript, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Initiates of the Ebon Hand by paying {1}, adding {B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1643-2073-3459-4659.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Clown Car from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Clown Car enters the battlefield, triggering Battered Golem, untapping Battered Golem.
Activate Clown Car's crew ability by tapping Battered Golem, causing Clown Car to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Clown Car, adding {C}{C}.
Clown Car dies, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Repeat.

2773-4186-5017.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Urban Daggertooth has at least one +1/+1 counter.
2773-4186-5017.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
The Squirrel enters the battlefield, triggering Warstorm Surge, dealing 1 damage to Urban Daggertooth.
Urban Daggertooth triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and Scurry Oak.
Repeat from step 2.

967-2815-5078-5184.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Professional Face-Breaker by sacrificing a Treasure, exiling the top card of your library and allowing you to cast it this turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {1}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1283-1308-1684-2034-2178.notablePrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Rakka Mar.
1283-1308-1684-2034-2178.description:
Activate Rakka Mar by paying {1} and tapping it to create two Elemental token with haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Elemental token, adding {C}{C}.
Rakka Mar triggers, untapping.
Repeat.

23-776-1329-1540.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Orcish Vandal do not have summoning sickness.
23-776-1329-1540.description:
Tap Orcish Vandal, sacrificing Chalice of the Void to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Chalice of the Void.
Cast Chalice of the Void.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1090-1987-4344.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Lumbering Battlement and any land you control.
Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, causing Restoration Angel to return to the battlefield.
Restoration Angel and Lumbering Battlement enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Lumbering Battlement trigger, exiling Restoration Angel until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Restoration Angel trigger, blinking Lumbering Battlement.
Repeat from step 2.

1987-2427-3277-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Gilded Lotus and Izzet Chronarch, blinking them.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.

215-930-2757-5301.description:
Cast Universal Automaton by paying {1}.
Rin and Seri triggers twice, creating a 1/1 Cat and a 1/1 Dog creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Cat token, untapping a basic Forest you control.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times, tapping the Dog token and Universal Automaton respectively.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Universal Automaton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

739-2749-3350.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Axis of Mortality triggers.
Activate Wall of Blood by paying 1 life, giving Wall of Blood +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat step 2 until you have zero life.
Resolve the Axis of Mortality trigger, swapping your life total with an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
You may repeat this on each of your turns.
